description: This file defines the Regex class in the Composer\Pcre namespace, providing static methods for regex matching, replacing, and related operations, utilizing an external Preg class.

classes.name: Regex
classes.description: A utility class providing static methods for regex operations in the Composer\Pcre namespace.

methods.name: isMatch
methods.description: Checks if the pattern matches the subject string.

methods.name: match
methods.description: Performs regex match and returns a MatchResult object.

methods.name: matchStrictGroups
methods.description: Performs regex match with strict group matching, throws if null matches are encountered.

methods.name: matchWithOffsets
methods.description: Performs regex match with offset capture, returns a MatchWithOffsetsResult.

methods.name: matchAll
methods.description: Performs regex match all and returns a MatchAllResult.

methods.name: matchAllStrictGroups
methods.description: Performs match all with strict groups, throws on null matches.

methods.name: matchAllWithOffsets
methods.description: Performs match all with offsets, returns a MatchAllWithOffsetsResult.

methods.name: replaceCallback
methods.description: Performs regex replacement with a callback.

methods.name: replaceCallbackStrictGroups
methods.description: Performs callback replacement with strict group handling.
